name: Anemo DMG
description:
Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
Every 1 Elemental Mastery increases the specified effect by a factor of 1.
Cryo Swirl: DMG +1, deals 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing characters except the target
Hydro Swirl: DMG +1, deals 1 Hydro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
Pyro Swirl: DMG +1, deals 1 Pyro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
Electro Swirl: DMG +1, deals 1 Electro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
